findings.title: Structural drift: naming
findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#数据建模规范（架构 §5.2 · 决策 #50 / #58）
Note: Both new models use the foreign-key column `draft_id` as the primary key instead of the mandated `id String @id @default(ulid())`, and omit the fixed common columns (`updatedAt`, `deletedAt`) — same shape in `IngestDraftRevision` (`draftId String @id @map("draft_id")`). The doc requires a String ULID primary key generated by the Prisma application layer and the fixed four common columns on models.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#数据建模规范（架构 §5.2 · 决策 #50 / #58）.

findings.title: Structural drift: other
findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#Prisma 7.5 操作规范（不用 Prisma enum；受控词表走表，#13/#55）
Note: The closed vocabulary of revision target kinds is inlined as a DDL CHECK constraint (and repeated in TypeScript unions/casts) instead of living in a controlled-vocabulary table as the doc requires; the same list now exists in three places (DDL, `RevisionKind`, `toDetail` cast).

notes: No non-bot, non-author reviewer comments were supplied, so maintainer overlap cannot be assessed and remains unflagged.
The PR body only links to external artefacts (hiapi-cli PR #18, hiapi-cli issue #17); their content is not included, so no claims are sourced from them.

Verification statements excluded from claims: 571 tests passed / 0 failed (55 files, 2080 assertions); content-api/content-sdk/manage typecheck and ESLint passing; all 73 migrations replayed on a fresh PostgreSQL test database; real Rust CLI to local HTTP API to PostgreSQL end-to-end check.

CI history excluded from claims: run 44658696801 not started due to account limits, run 44669467061 executed checks, content-api had one failure (unregistered revise write route), quality missing dashboard route type, site cancelled at checkout.

Review-fix checks excluded from claims: targeted 18 tests / 0 failed / 30 assertions, 13 tests / 97 assertions, ESLint and type checks after commit a9c7d081; the author states the earlier 571-test run was not repeated on the latest head.

Author scopes the PR as non-deploying and non-content-modifying, and states that staging acceptance of two Showcase items and accepted content is still pending deployment, and that local regression does not equal full-repo or production acceptance.
The PR body asserts the branch was merged with dev 57d84c74 including 5e09d9fe's dashboard route tree and paraglide pre-generation; this is a merge/verification statement, not a functional claim.
This slice contains only documentation and task-tracking files; no production code, migration, SDK or test files are present here, so claims c1-c9 are omitted rather than assessed as undelivered.

The spec section in .trellis/spec/content-api/backend/ingest-transcriber-guidelines.md describes contracts matching c4 (forbidden keys fail atomically), c6 (unambiguous or explicitly verified legacy target), c7 (generic revision acceptance skips production-converge/translation/topic dispatch) and c8 (modify and rejected-derivation rejected), but description in a spec document is design intent, not implementation evidence.

implement.md records that an earlier CI run failed because POST /admin/drafts/:id/revise was missing from STAFF_WRITE_ROUTES and that a follow-up registers it (relevant to c9); the actual guard registration lives in a file outside this slice and cannot be verified here.

implement.md also records an earlier Actions run blocked by billing/spending limits and that live staging verification is still pending, which is consistent with c10's deployment gate but not proof of it.
This slice covers admin routing, schema/migration, read projection, and planning/validation docs; service implementations and tests referenced by other changed files are not included.
Where behavior depends on service code not present in this slice, evidence is limited to the route, schema, and author-reported validation/rollout text.

This slice covers 7 of 30 changed files; claims c9 (write-route guard registration) and c10 (migration rollout ordering) have no evidence here and are intentionally omitted rather than marked undelivered.
Line ranges for newly added files are derived by counting added lines from the hunk headers.

c10 is not evidenced in this slice: db-harness.ts only extends the TRUNCATE table list with ingest_draft_revision and ingest_draft_acceptance, which implies the new tables exist but says nothing about migration-before-deploy ordering or rollback constraints.

All SDK schema/test additions (AdminDraftReviseRequest/Response, AdminShowcaseCopyPatch, acceptedEntityId, revision detail block, affectsPublishedContent, reused) map to the stated claims; no untraceable changes found in this slice.
